_about: Days on which the 2004 Martyrologium Romanum (editio typica altera, https://archive.org/details/MartRom2004) lists saints, keyed by Wikipedia article. 'entry' is the saint's line in the book's index of names, as OCR'd (errors kept so it can be checked); Scripts/check_martyrology.py confirms every line is in the index and carries the date. The app shows saints on their celebrated day and adds this day on the card when it differs; it never moves a saint. Matched by name and death year, or looked up by Codex in the index and checked; each match was read before it was kept.
